title: Nifty Auto jumps over 2%; Maruti, TVS Motor, Ashok Leyland, M&M among top gainers. Why are auto stocks rising?
summary: On Thursday morning, major auto stocks, such as Maruti, TVS Motor, Ashok Leyland, Mahindra and Mahindra, Hero MotoCorp, and Eicher Motors, rose more than 2% each.
